description: §6.6.9 / §20.5 (S449 ruling item 1) — `@session.userId` read inside a server function is E-SESSION-AMBIENT-SERVER. Before S449 it lowered to `_scrml_body["session"].userId` — the CLIENT request body — so a caller could write any identity (measured: POST {"session":{"userId":"victim"}} wrote a row as "victim"). Exactly one report per read: the codegen backstop E-INTERNAL-SESSION-AMBIENT-SERVER does not stack on top.
rationale: §6.6.9: '`@session` is server-only identity and SHALL NEVER be marshalled from the client — doing so would be a spoofing hole.' Ruling (user-voice-scrml.md S449 item 1): interim compile error naming `session.<field>`.
